name: Product development system
outcome: A bounded product slice is implemented in isolation, independently checked, and only reaches public product main after an explicit H2 approval with fail-closed evidence.

verifier.green_means: Remote public main contains only the approved slice; pre-push suite was GREEN; no unrelated concurrent work was swept; H2 approval is bound to the exact commit digest.

stop.success: The independent release checker accepts the H2 packet and public main digest match.

nodes.name: Frame the product slice
nodes.outcome: One outcome, acceptance criteria, and blast radius are written before implementation starts.

contract.goal: Seal a one-slice goal with external acceptance criteria and explicit non-goals.

verifier.green_means: Goal is one sentence, acceptance is machine-or-reviewer checkable, and NOT-build / out-of-scope items are listed.

stop.success: Scope reviewer accepts the frame packet.

nodes.name: Implement in an isolated worktree
nodes.outcome: The slice lands as a clean commit on a dedicated branch/worktree without sweeping concurrent work.

contract.goal: Implement only the framed slice on an isolated branch with maker≠checker review of the diff scope.

verifier.green_means: Diff matches the frame; no unrelated files; no secrets; worktree remains clean after commit.

stop.success: Diff-scope reviewer accepts the implementation commit.

nodes.name: Run independent verification
nodes.outcome: Tier-0 suite and product checks are GREEN outside the implementer context.

contract.goal: Re-run pytest, doctors, and any slice-specific checks from a clean tree; implementer self-report is not sufficient.

verifier.green_means: pytest and looptimal-doctor exit 0 on the candidate tree.

stop.success: Independent checker records GREEN suite results.

nodes.name: Approve product-public push (H2)
nodes.outcome: A named human explicitly approves pushing the exact candidate commit to public product main.
evidence: timestamped H2 approval bound to commit digest

nodes.name: Land on public main
nodes.outcome: origin/main advances to the approved commit without force-push or unrelated commits.

contract.goal: Push only the approved commit to public main and verify remote digest match.

verifier.green_means: origin/main equals the approved commit; no force-push; post-push smoke for the slice still GREEN.
